opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with dates, guests, filters and price sort
opportunities.description: Search Kayak hotels for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {guests}, optionally apply {filters}, and sort by price (low to high).
steps: Click 'Search for hotels'
Type the destination into 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark' and pick the matching suggestion
Select the check-in date in the calendar
Select the check-out date
Open the rooms/guests selector and use Increment to set adults/children (and child ages)
Click Search/Update
Optionally apply filters (review score, stars, free internet, style, amenities)
Open the sort control and choose 'Price (low to high)'

instances.values: destination=Le Marais, Paris; dates 27→2; guests +2; sort Price low to high

destination=Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; dates 6→10; guests +3, child age 7; filters 8+ rating, 3 stars, Free internet, Family style, Air-conditioned; sort Price low to high (interrupted by a Qatar flight-status lookup)

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways flights from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date} with {passengers} in {cabin_class}, then show flights and pick a fare.
steps: Type the origin in the 'From' field and pick the suggestion
Set the destination (type in the 'To' field, or pick it from Explore)
Open the depart date picker and choose the date (one-way)
Open 'Passengers / Class' and adjust the adult/child/infant counts
Choose the cabin class if needed, then click Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
Click the chosen fare price and click 'Select fare' for each leg

instances.values: Colombo→New York; 24 June 2023; −1 infant, +1 child; Business/First; fares LKR 1,120,521 and LKR 3,125,932 (interrupted by IGN browsing)
Destination Durban picked via Explore > Africa; from Doha; 28 May 2023; +1 infant; fare QAR 4,980

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways hotels in {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out}, set {guests/rooms}, then sort by lowest price or open a property to reserve.
steps: Click 'Book', then the 'Hotels' link
Type the destination in the search box and pick the matching option
Select the check-in and check-out dates in the calendar
Click Search
Optionally adjust the guests/rooms selector and click Done
Either sort by 'Price (lowest first)' or apply filters, open a property, click 'See availability', then 'Reserve'

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; 10–16 April 2023; sort by Price (lowest first)
Washington DC; ~25 May → 5 June 2023; guests adjusted; filters applied; See availability → Reserve
